question: Estimate the monthly fresh fruit sales in Crawford Market, Mumbai.
idealClarificationQuestions: Wholesale fruit market (largest in Mumbai)? Yes.
Daily / monthly fresh fruit throughput? Monthly.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Mumbai fruit consumption × Crawford share of wholesale.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Mumbai population: ~22M; per-capita fruit consumption: ~35 kg/year (urban higher).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Crawford Market + APMC Vashi (major Mumbai wholesale fruit markets combined): ~60% of wholesale = ~28,800 tonnes/month at Crawford+Vashi.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Crawford Market alone (a smaller share, mostly retail-feeding)

calculationFlow: Annual Mumbai fruit consumption: 22M × 35 kg = ~770 million kg = 7.7 lakh tonnes/year.
Crawford Market + APMC Vashi (major Mumbai wholesale fruit markets combined): ~60% of wholesale = ~28,800 tonnes/month at Crawford+Vashi.
Crawford Market alone (a smaller share, mostly retail-feeding): ~25-30% of that = ~8,000-9,000 tonnes/month.
